model.clock: physical propagation time; no arithmetic or fitted target clock
model.equation: i d_t psi=H_(gamma,kappa) psi with H=[[i gamma,kappa],[kappa,-i gamma]]
model.parameters: kappa>0 and gamma real; physical time t
model.parity_time: P=sigma_x and T is componentwise complex conjugation
model.state_space: nonzero vectors psi in C^2 and their projective rays

nonclaims: the PT dimer, exceptional points, and pseudo-Hermitian metrics are established literature and are not claimed as newly discovered

the standard Euclidean norm is not conserved when gamma is nonzero

proof_contract.classification: use the sign of delta=kappa^2-gamma^2 and the Jordan form at delta=0
proof_contract.exponential: reduce every analytic power series to the basis I,H using the scalar square identity
proof_contract.finite_role: the integer grid audits exact algebra, phase labels, metrics, and boundary incidence but is not the proof of the all-parameter theorem
proof_contract.metric: direct multiplication gives H^dagger eta=eta H and eta eigenvalues 1 plus or minus |gamma|/kappa
proof_contract.period: the scalar exponential is plus or minus I at successive half turns; eigenrays are stationary and are excluded from the generic least-period statement
proof_contract.projective: differentiate the affine ratio and compactify the Riccati field on CP^1

theorem_contract.boundaries: gamma=0, kappa down to zero, both exceptional sheets, eigenrays, zero state, and vector-versus-ray periods are separated
theorem_contract.broken: if |gamma|>kappa, the two projective fixed rays are attracting and repelling and generic vector norms have exponential envelopes
theorem_contract.exceptional: if |gamma|=kappa, H is nonzero rank-one nilpotent, the eigenline is unique, and generalized states grow linearly
theorem_contract.metrics: sigma_x is an all-parameter conserved indefinite form; eta=I+(gamma/kappa)sigma_y is positive definite exactly in the unbroken chamber and degenerates at the exceptional point
theorem_contract.projective: z=psi_2/psi_1 obeys z_dot=i kappa(z^2-1)-2 gamma z and its complex quadratic discriminant is minus four times (kappa^2-gamma^2)
theorem_contract.square: H^2=(kappa^2-gamma^2) I gives the exact exponential in all three chambers
theorem_contract.unbroken: if |gamma|<kappa, eigenvalues are real, generic rays have least period pi/sqrt(kappa^2-gamma^2), and vectors have least period twice that
